summary: Palvella Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing positive clinical data from its Phase 3 SELVA and Phase 2 TOIVA studies of QTORIN rapamycin, presented at the ISSVA World Congress 2026. The press release reports efficacy endpoints such as mLM-IGA scores in microcystic lymphatic malformation patients. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is disclosed. The filing is a routine clinical data update with no deal terms or special-situation mechanics. There is no actionable risk-arb angle; the event is purely operational and regulatory in nature.
